mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.employee_code, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, u.phone, u.avatar_url, u.department_id, u.org_node_id, u.keycloak_username, u.status, u.two_factor_enabled, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_elements FROM iam.users u WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY u.full_name ASC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
